timeline.summary: Parin Enterprises announced board approval for migrating its equity shares from the SME Platform to the Main Board of NSE.
Parin Enterprises received a ₹32.34 lakh order from Airport Authority of India to supply airport furniture to Kullu Manali Airport, Himachal Pradesh.
Parin Enterprises shareholders approved migration from SME platform to NSE Main Board via postal ballot with 100% votes in favour.
Parin Enterprises received a ₹3.69 Cr contract from PSP Projects & Proactive Constructions Private Limited to supply furniture to the Adani – Mundra Staff Accommodation, intimated on 29 May 2026.
Parin Enterprises received a ₹3.13 Cr contract from PSP Projects Limited to supply furniture to the Adani – Mundra Staff Accommodation, intimated 29 May 2026.
Q2FY27 results (consolidated): revenue ₹85.43 Cr, net profit to shareholders ₹7.96 Cr.
